title: FixtureManifest
description: PRD §5.4 — per-fixture metadata consumed by load_seeded_opportunities and the eval harness.

slug.description: Kebab-case identifier; must match the fixture directory name.

expected_decision_band.description: Expected FitScore decision the agent should produce for this fixture.

opportunity.description: Full Opportunity record seeded into the DB for this fixture.

attachments.description: Attachment files shipped with this fixture under attachments/.

filename.description: Basename of the file under fixtures/<slug>/attachments/.

kind.description: Document role used by the extraction pipeline.

expected_critical_blockers.description: Blocker labels the eval harness checks for in ExtractedRequirement rows (is_blocker=true).

expected_partner_suggestion.description: Whether the agent is expected to recommend a teaming partner for this fixture.
